title: Open-Meteo historical archive – Olympic Valley grid point, 20-28 June 2026
claims: The returned grid point is 39.1916 N, 120.2063 W at an elevation of 1,900 m.
Daily maximum temperature from 20 to 28 June 2026 ranged from 15.1 to 26.4 degrees C with a median of 24.2 degrees C.
Daily minimum temperature from 20 to 28 June 2026 ranged from 2.9 to 9.2 degrees C with a median of 5.9 degrees C.
One of the nine days had at least 1 mm of precipitation and none had at least 5 mm; 26 June recorded 1.1 mm and 27 June recorded 0.3 mm.
On 27 June 2026 the grid point recorded a maximum of 15.1 degrees C, a minimum of 4.5 degrees C and 0.3 mm of precipitation.
These are modelled grid-point values, not measurements taken on the race course.
The grid point is at 1,900 m, close to the official 6,200 ft start elevation.
